report_context.sample_note: This run stores 1,000 exact image files and verifies every SHA-256 checksum before inference. It uses 200 deterministic samples from each of five classes.
report_context.source_note: All images come from LC25000. The dataset contains augmented derivatives of a smaller original collection, so samples are not patient-independent.

prompts.benign lung tissue: benign lung tissue with open alveolar spaces, delicate septa, bland pneumocytes, and no cytologic atypia
prompts.lung adenocarcinoma: lung adenocarcinoma with malignant gland formation, acinar or lepidic growth, atypical columnar cells, and possible mucin
prompts.lung squamous cell carcinoma: lung squamous cell carcinoma with atypical squamous nests, keratin pearls, intercellular bridges, and eosinophilic cytoplasm

prompts.benign colonic tissue: benign colonic tissue with orderly parallel crypts, uniform goblet cells, preserved lamina propria, and no dysplasia
prompts.colorectal adenocarcinoma: colorectal adenocarcinoma with infiltrative irregular glands, hyperchromatic stratified nuclei, luminal dirty necrosis, and desmoplastic stroma
